title: A render that is not reproducible cannot be used as a measuring instrument
problem: Confirm that regenerating an output produces the same bytes.
failure: Two runs gave an identical byte count and different bytes, and the re-run had already overwritten the artifact under comparison.
correction: A task that re-runs a generator must state what happens to the previous output.
transfer: A bench that cannot reproduce a byte sequence cannot be asked to certify one.
limits: FIXTURE. Test data for tests/retrieval_bilingual_R02.py. Serves as the unrelated negative control: no query about retrieval, identity or permissions should return it.
